correctness.rationale: The Homma-Kim normal form identifies plane-filling quintics by 3x3 matrices modulo scalars; irreducible cubic characteristic polynomial is the published smoothness criterion. Eight irreducible cubics split into affine-polynomial orbits of sizes 2,6, yielding 144 and 432 scalar-normalized models in two rational projective classes. For their displayed representatives, six extension counts determine all 12 genus-six Weil numerator coefficients by Newton identities and functional equation: P_s=(1+3T+5T^2+9T^3+9T^4)^3; P_g has coefficients (1,9,42,131,308,601,1067,1803,2772,3537,3402,2187,729). Independent polynomial arithmetic checked both numerator reconstructions and mod-2 irreducibility of quartic and degree-12 factor, confirming simple ordinary abelian surface cubed versus simple ordinary sixfold and P_s(1)=19683, P_g(1)=16589. Independently enumerated projective points by finite-field polynomial-basis arithmetic for n=1..4, reproducing first four counts of both tables, and inspected source exact verifiers for higher two levels. Finite fields n<=4 alone do NOT determine zeta without the cited smooth genus-six functional equation and certified remaining two counts.
